comparison.description: Two or more states, options, or groups set side by side on the same measure.

process_sequence.description: Ordered steps or stages, where the order is the point.

temporal_trend.description: One or more measures across ordered time periods, where the direction of change is the point.

distribution.description: How values or shares spread across categories or ranges.

relationship.description: How two variables move together, or how entities connect.

scientific_mechanism.description: How a biological, chemical, or technical system produces its result.

quantitative_result.description: One or two headline figures that carry the claim on their own.

evidence_matrix.description: Values across several items and attributes, read by lookup.

risk_register.description: Objections, risks, or open questions, each with a response.

mixed_evidence.description: A figure and qualitative support (a quote, an observation) that together make the claim.

contextual_explanation.description: Reasons, context, or background best carried in words.

navy.use: Headlines, primary figures, the proof series in charts, dark slide backgrounds

ochre.use: One point of emphasis per slide at most: marker squares, a single flagged data point, section numbers on dark slides. Never body text on white

slate.use: Body text, labels, sources, slide numbers

mist.use: Context series in charts, secondary text on dark slides, hairline dividers

fonts.head: Cambria
fonts.note: Chosen for portability: both ship with Office and render true-to-width in QA. The Helix brand faces (Tiempos Headline, Inter) are a designer decision for the next pass.

variant_policy.rule: Within a layout type, cycle through variants in order. Skip a variant if the previous slide used the same layout id, and skip any variant whose capacity the slide's content exceeds. A spec slide may pin `variant` to override the cycle.

conventions.layout_names: Layout names in the PowerPoint layout menu equal the manifest id (type.variant).
conventions.placeholder_names: Layout placeholders carry the manifest placeholder name. On rendered slides each filled shape is renamed '<slide_id>/<placeholder>' so the sync step can match it.
conventions.regions: A region placeholder marks where the renderer draws a chart, diagram, table, or stage graphic. The renderer removes the placeholder and draws native shapes or a native chart in its box.
conventions.maps_to: Paths into the spec. 'evidence.primary' is the slide's evidence item with role 'primary' and placement 'slide'. 'body.read#1' and '#2' mean the read prose split across two columns at a sentence boundary.
